scope: Read-only staged implementation review, no app/bank edits; no full suite concurrent.

findings.problem: Any nonempty case/casestudy child answer object counts as attempted, including an essay typing draft or submitted:false structured child answer. App handleFinishQuiz saves raw answers, so history can contain such drafts. These parents then disappear from remaining count and can cause next-batch selection to skip unpractised content.
findings.evidence: Bundled actual helper via esbuild and executed case1 / essay1 {text:unsubmitted draft} historical answer: attemptedPracticeIds returned [case1]. App.tsx:701 saves raw answers. committedAnswer.ts already distinguishes graded/submitted child answers and accepts numeric0/booleanfalse.
findings.recommendation: Use shared committedAnswer semantics for case parents (and structured essays); count a case as practised only when at least one actual child answer is committed.
findings.resolution: Case parent uses shared committedAnswer semantics; new regression rejects typing draft, preserves child MCQ0.

findings.problem: Card attempted/completed display uses existing moduleProgress, which does not filter chapter or current content version. New batch remaining/advance uses version-aware attemptedPracticeIds. After edited content versions, cards can remain Completed /20of20 while dialog correctly says20 not yet practised.
findings.evidence: moduleProgress.ts filters module and parentID only; practiceNavigation.ts filters chapter and version. ChapterTopicList.tsx uses moduleProgress.attempted to calculate completed.
findings.recommendation: Use the same chapter-scoped current-version attempted IDs for card practice counts/completion; preserve existing objective accuracy/XP behavior.
findings.resolution: SubjectSelect provides current-version attemptedIds to ChapterTopicList; card counts/completion derive same IDs as remaining/batch selection. Changed-version regression rejects stale Completed state.

checks_passed_static: Explicit multi-branch module allowlist plus MSS chapter9/past-exam guard; requires multiple active distinct recognized branch IDs. Single-branch and subject-first aliases do not introduce subject step.
Original chapter array and subjectIndex topic keys preserved while scoped topic lists are filtered; custom picker Select all stays within chosen branch.
20/40 stable slices preserve canonical order and original question IDs; whole-topic remains available; short-topic starts whole immediately.

Draft selection validates exact saved questionID set and version vector, prioritizes valid unfinished drafts by timestamp, then first chunk with unattempted member. Completed chunks remain available as review after exhaustion.
MCQ0 and TFfalse accepted as attempted; matching/fillblank only submitted answers counted in direct parent history.
Same-named topic result lookup uses topic.key; legacy title fallback allowed only when title unambiguous in entire chapter.
App branch state persists when quiz/results return to topic screen; reset on chapter/module and explicit back-to-chapters.
Native dialogs use showModal, labelled heading, Escape/cancel, explicit close, saved overflow restoration and focus cleanup. CSS constrains width/height and provides44/48px controls.
No modifications to grading, canonical question payload, XP submission or source bank data in reviewed navigation implementation.
Case typing/structured child drafts rejected; committed0/false retained.
Cards and batch picker share current-version attempted IDs, avoiding stale completion.
Cloud canonical server hashes separated from browser assessment hashes; no grading or XP changes.
Async progress lookup errors expose retry and whole-topic fallback rather than enabling a potentially incorrect next batch.
